historical_comparison.member_comparison_method: Ordered type/ref/role tuples; Overpass embedded geometry is compared separately, not treated as relation membership.

repair_proposal.required_decision: A qualified OSM mapper must assess whether the coincident endpoint objects represent the same boundary vertex or whether a different source-backed membership correction is required. Equal coordinates alone do not authorize consolidation.
preconditions: Review complete node/way histories, tags and all reverse usages.
Verify the intended boundary from original mapping sources; do not infer jurisdiction from the ring.
Recheck live versions immediately before any separately authorized editor action.
Validate affected shared ways and all parent relations in an OSM editor; do not add fictitious segments.
Use a narrowly scoped documented changeset and community procedures if an edit is authorized.
After an upstream correction, recapture full/history and rerun complete source, topology, geometry, ACTUAL and CI gates.
